newsitem.title: USA: L-3 Communications Corp sells $225 mln 144A notes.
newsitem.headline: L-3 Communications Corp sells $225 mln 144A notes.

text.p: The following issue from L-3 Communications Corp was priced in the 144A private placement market on Friday via Lehman Brothers Inc, according to market sources.
The deal was increased to $225 million from an original size of $200 million, market sources added.
L-3 Communications is a new company being formed by the spin-off of the high-tech communications units of Lockheed Martin Corp.
